description: Diagnosing fespalier failures where the message or the symptom does not name the cause — every fsp diagnostic grouped by area (folder names, view files, binding and types, data.dart, guards, tabs and navigators, config, meta, localized paths) with its cause and fix, plus the Flutter-side traps of this project: a stale app.g.dart that fsp check cannot see, parameters silently turned into query parameters, unreachable routes, case sensitivity, the ListTile ink assertion, a login page that shows not_found, the run-time messages of fespalier_auth, fespalier_flags, fespalier_storage, fespalier_connectivity and fespalier_dio (the Dio and package:http companion; since 0.9.0), fespalier_tolgee (translations) and fespalier_cratestack (offline-first, CrateStack; since 0.10.0), and documentation claims that are false. Load when fsp prints an error or warning, flutter analyze fails inside app.g.dart, a URL shows not_found.dart or the wrong page, or a doc and the code disagree.
